Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the fruit and vegetable district fund.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the fruit and vegetable district fund; andamending RCW 15.17.243.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 15.17.243 and 2005 c 49 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The district manager for district two as defined in WAC ((16458075)) 16390010 is authorized to transfer ((two)) one hundred fiftythousand dollars from the fruit and vegetable district fund to theplant pest account within the agricultural local fund. The amounttransferred is to be derived from fees collected for state inspectionsof tree fruits and is to be used solely for activities related to thecontrol of Rhagoletis pomonella in district two. The transfer of fundsshall occur by ((June 1, 1997)) July 1, 2009. On June 30, ((2009))2013, any unexpended portion of the ((two)) one hundred fifty thousanddollars shall be transferred to the fruit and vegetable inspectionaccount and deposited in the district account for the district thatincludes Yakima county.
